title: Wear-IT Item Specification
description: This specification contains all the needed information to describe a single item or scale used within the Wear-IT framework, including its conceptual, psychometric, and delivery properties.

examples.itemText: How stressed did you feel today?

itemText.description: Exact text of the item as presented.

conceptualization.description: What construct or concept does this item measure or represent?

typicalModelingUse.description: Usual modeling characteristics or how this item is typically used in analysis (e.g. predictor, outcome, mediator, covariate).

isValidated.description: Whether this item is part of a statistically validated measure.

scaleName.description: Name of the scale this item belongs to.

parentScale.description: Name of the parent scale if this item belongs to a subscale.

subScale.description: Name of the subscale this item belongs to, if applicable.

scaleOrItem.description: Whether this entry represents a full scale or a single item.

typeOfScale.description: The type of scale this item uses (e.g. Likert, VAS, semantic differential, binary, forced choice).

scoring.description: How this item or scale is scored, including any summing, averaging, or weighting rules.

isReverseCoded.description: Whether this item is reverse coded or otherwise transformed before use.

transformation.description: Description of any transformation applied to this item beyond simple reverse coding.

containsIdentifyingInfo.description: Whether this item potentially contains personally identifying information.

dataType.description: Type of data this item produces.

timeStem.description: The time reference embedded in the item (e.g. 'in the past week', 'right now', 'today').

topLevelQuestion.description: The top-level or parent question this item falls under, if it is a sub-item.

anchorsNumeric.description: Numeric mapping of response anchors (e.g. 1 = strongly disagree, 5 = strongly agree).

anchorsNominal.description: Nominal or text-based response options or categories (e.g. yes/no, never/sometimes/always).

deliveryMechanism.description: How the item is delivered to the participant (e.g. mobile app, paper, wearable, passive sensor, interviewer).

deliveryFrequency.description: How frequently this item is delivered (e.g. once daily, every 4 hours, event-contingent).

citation.description: Citation for the item or scale source.

notes.description: Any additional notes about this item.
